character: A remote resort in far northern Vermont, a few miles from the Canadian border, known for high natural snowfall and extensive glades. It has an aerial tram, slopeside hotels and an indoor waterpark.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base areas. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79/I-88 to Albany, I-87 N to Champlain, US-2 across Lake Champlain at Rouses Point, then VT-78/VT-105 E via Swanton, Enosburg Falls and Richford to Jay); not a routing-service result. A route via Watertown and US-11 across northern NY is shorter but on slower two-lane roads. Winter weather adds time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-89 N to St. Albans, then VT-105 E via Enosburg Falls and Richford to Jay); not a routing-service result.
